A '''hydro-clamp''' was a piece of technology known for its gripping strength. Survivors of [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] attacks likened the strength of the creature's [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]] to being as strong as a hydro-clamp.<ref name="CCG-Tentacle">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Tentacle}}</ref>
